svg.aria-label: Your model. Your tools. Bring your key. Keep your workflow. KaDeep Studio runs on the model key you already pay for, or the coding agent already on your machine: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Cursor and more. It files what it finds where your team already works: Jira, Slack, Linear, GitHub and more. Dots flow from each model into the KaDeep Studio tile and out to each tool.
